title: Earnings
heading: Earnings
shrinkage_value: at selling prices {amount} — what colleagues did not pay
net_profit_hint: Gross profit minus shrinkage at purchase prices — only for lots with a purchase price, like the gross profit. Own consumption is left out.
margin_below_break_even: The achieved margin does not cover the shrinkage — the fridge costs you money.
margin_help: Suggested price = cost + margin, rounded up to whole {currency}. 0 % = at cost.
limit_warn: You are close to the yearly limit: received {amount} of {limit} ({percent}).
limit_exceeded: The yearly limit is exceeded: received {amount} of {limit} ({percent}).
limit_note: Counted by payment date: received = invoices other people paid you this year; pending = unpaid invoices and purchases not invoiced yet. Own consumption does not count. The limit is only for your overview — nothing is blocked and no e-mail is sent. This is not tax advice.
gross_profit_basis: of {amount} sales with a purchase price
net_profit_unknown: Without purchase prices the profit cannot be told.
margin_old_prices: The set margin is enough, but some stock still sells at old prices. Adjust the prices when you next stock up.
